backendStructuredError.message: Нельзя удалить подписку: её сервер сейчас активен. Сначала отключите или замените активный сервер.

apiWrapperBehavior: The subscription API wrapper captures the structured service error only as error.details and replaces both the public code and public message with SUBSCRIPTION_OPERATION_FAILED and a generic message.
frontendBehavior: subscriptions.js displays payload.error.message, so the specific safety instruction is not visible.
securityRequirement: Expose only a validated final BRORAY_ERROR marker; keep arbitrary stderr private and retain the generic fallback for unstructured failures.
implementationPlan: parse the final BRORAY_ERROR line in the API wrapper
validate the error code syntax and non-empty message
map known conflict and not-found codes to appropriate HTTP status
return the structured code and message without raw stderr details
retain SUBSCRIPTION_OPERATION_FAILED for all unstructured errors
